name: Arts and recreation

bnote.920002: Delta Corp runs casinos in Goa and Sikkim. Las Vegas Sands is a large listed casino operator.
bnote.932100: India's two listed amusement-park operators, plus Six Flags.

flags.deltacorp: Delta Corp is loss-making after a large GST demand on online gaming.
flags.fun: Six Flags booked large write-downs, so net profit is negative.

notes: Most arts, museums and heritage activities are not run by listed companies. Gambling, parks, gyms and sports clubs are covered.
